annotation.title_clean: Commission Decision of 20 April 2004 on the publication of the reference of standard EN 12180:2000 'Non-active surgical implants — Body contouring implants — Specific requirements for mammary implants' in accordance with Council Directive 93/42/EEC
annotation.title_en: Commission Decision of 20 April 2004 on the publication of the reference of standard EN 12180:2000 'Non-active surgical implants — Body contouring implants — Specific requirements for mammary implants' in accordance with Council Directive 93/42/EEC
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 120/48
annotation.summary_en: 2004 Commission Decision withdrawing the Official Journal citation of standard EN 12180:2000 on mammary implants under Medical Devices Directive 93/42/EEC, so it no longer gives presumption of conformity. Unrelated to AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Reference of EN 12180:2000 is withdrawn from the list of published harmonised standards.
The standard no longer confers presumption of conformity with Directive 93/42/EEC.
Decision follows CEN's request and new mandate M/320 on breast implants.
